The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declines to generate a fresh key per retry attempt
- Explains that the same key must be reused on a retry of the same business action, since a new key on retry risks a duplicate payment
- Distinguishes this from the case where the original attempt was genuinely rejected, where a new key is correct

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
